title: The Masterpiece
desc: A young man falls in with the wrong crowd and strays from heroic deeds. However, an accidental encounter with danger forces him to change his ways.

title: Aadikeshava
desc: Following the death of his biological father, a man travels to Rayalaseema to protect his sister and his ancestral temple.

title: Bharathchandran I.P.S.
desc: Hyder Ali Hassan, a scheming politician, is in league with the underworld and runs a lot of illegal businesses. Balachandran, an IPS officer, is sent on a mission to capture him.

title: Garudan
desc: The loyal shadow of two childhood friends, Sokkan, grapples with allegiance and betrayal after a temple's riches come between all of them.

title: Biriyani
desc: Sugan and Parasuram leave Varadharajan's party drunk in search of a place to have biryani. Soon, they get into some serious trouble when they find a corpse in the trunk of their car.
Sethuraman, a scientist, invents a time-travelling gadget that his evil twin Athreya wants to get hold of. Soon, a bitter battle arises between Sethuraman's son and Athreya.
